name: io.github.AI-Shopping-Feeds/youtube-studio-mcp
description: YouTube MCP: bulk video uploads, metadata, playlists, captions, live and analytics.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your Google OAuth Desktop client JSON.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the token JSON written by `youtube-studio-mcp auth-init`.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder that local uploads must come from.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: When 'true', writes and uploads are logged but not sent.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_TOOL_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated tool groups to register (channels, videos, uploads, playlists, comments, captions, search, live, analytics, raw). Empty means all.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When 'true', only read-only tools are registered.
